title: BRIC aims at USD 300 billion Indian bioeconomy by 2030 and USD 1 trillion by 2047: Jitendra Singh

ai.summary: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh announced BRIC's target of USD 300 billion Indian bioeconomy by 2030 and USD 1 trillion by 2047 during its annual meeting in New Delhi.

facts.claim: BRIC aims at USD 300 billion Indian bioeconomy by 2030 and a USD 1 trillion bioeconomy by 2047
facts.quote: New Delhi, Nov 21: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh said today that BRIC aims at USD 300 billion Indian bioeconomy by 2030 and a USD 1 trillion bioeconomy by 2047.
